metadata.title: Uber and Lucid team up to bring robotaxis to Houston

content.text:
Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian joins the show to discuss why Uber (UBER) and Lucid (LCID) chose Houston, Texas, as their next robotaxi market, what makes the city an attractive testing ground for autonomous ride-hailing and why there's so much riding on this launch for both companies.

So the Bay Area is the first the first area they're going to operate. Second area now is going to be Houston, which they announced. Uh testing's happening now. It's going to start in mid 2027. Uh so that's that's their, you know, Houston's a big metropolitan city, a great place for them to get to get set up. But the big thing is here is that they've secured a 50,000 square foot depot uh where they're going to handle all the logistics, right? The cleaning the cars, charging the cars, all the different things that that go with managing a fleet, right? So that's the big reason why Houston is the next it's the next uh territory for them is the fact that they're going to have this massive uh logistical operation there for their for their cars.
Why Houston by the way? Why that city?
You know, I think it's I mean, look, Texas has been a place where where, you know, Tesla operates in Austin, uh as as well as Waymo. I think it's just that Texas is more of a a friendly state in terms of regulation and Houston is just a massive uh metropolitan area. like just spread out. It's it's urban sprawl to the max, right? So that's actually where probably good for a robotaxi operation because you're kind of navigating amongst some urban, a lot of I guess they call it Surban. Suburban urban areas. I think this is a big uh kind of geographic footprint. It's a big uh kind of metropolitan area and I think it sort of makes sense if you're going to expand that in the south, why not try Houston or Dallas or some place like that.

You know, for Uber, it's it's sort of their momentum in the robotaxi space is they're they're building that, right? They they have a number of other deals in place, but this is their big one with with uh with Lucid. Now, for Lucid, it's even more important, right? This is a company that hasn't made a profit yet. Uh so for them, anything like this, any kind of venture like this that's additive revenue additive is a big deal.
